title: Junior Data Management Analyst
description: Salary Range: R$48,000.00 To R$54,000.00 Annually Full Time Position, Monday - Friday The Company Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers.KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers.Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities Launch your career in data management with Katalyst. As a Junior Data Management Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the intake, transfer, loading, quality control, cleanup, and delivery of geophysical and subsurface data for client projects. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will gain hands-on experience with seismic, non-seismic, and well data while developing a strong understanding of data governance standards, industry best practices, and Katalyst's proprietary tools and processes. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals who are detail-oriented, eager to learn, and interested in building technical expertise within the energy data management industry. The successful candidate will support both client site operations and internal project workflows, follow established procedures, communicate effectively with team members and clients, and contribute to the successful execution of data management projects while developing their professional and technical skills. Key Responsibilities: Support data management activities, including receipt, transfer, loading, validation, quality assurance, cleanup, organization, availability, and governance of files and data in accordance with established procedures. Monitor and organize data intake and output workflows through the Geophysical Data Network (RDG), client systems, and approved Katalyst tools. Perform operational procedures, complete checklists, conduct basic quality checks, and execute approved commands and scripts under appropriate guidance. Maintain accurate time tracking using corporate tools and support timely handling of billing-related information. Update control systems, spreadsheets, activity records, indicators, and operational documentation, including process notes, decision records, issue tracking, and status updates. Identify, record, and engage errors, inconsistencies, routine data issues, and technical concerns to the responsible analysts or project team members. Support data preparation, basic reporting, storage monitoring, disk usage review, workflow progress tracking, and data quality reporting as requested. Follow information security, confidentiality, and data governance standards when handling client, project, and company data. Communicate clearly and professionally with client personnel, Katalyst operational staff, and project team members to support effective project delivery. Qualifications & Skills: Working knowledge of data transfer concepts, file organization, and data loading processes, with a willingness to learn Katalyst and client-specific systems. Basic understanding of subsurface data types, including seismic, non-seismic, well data, related documents, and associated file formats. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented procedures accurately. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with basic proficiency in English. Ability to identify routine problems, document findings, cross-reference information, and escalation issues appropriately. Collaborative mindset with a strong team orientation and willingness to support shared project goals. Knowledge of key Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook. Basic knowledge of Linux commands used to browse, query, and copy files. Basic knowledge of Python or another programming language. Basic knowledge of file integrity checking and related quality control concepts. Strategic thinking and analytical capacity to review, compare, and connect information from multiple sources. Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain professionalism in a client-focused environment. Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: This is a full-time position. As a full-time position, the Junior Data Management Analyst is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location. This position may be performed remotely, at a Katalyst office, or on a client site. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening or weekend work required to support project or client needs. Required Education and Experience Undergraduate degree in data management, geoscience, information technology, databases, or a related field preferred. Minimum of two years of relevant experience in data management, geophysical or subsurface data support, data loading, data transfer, technical operations, or a related analytical environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Banco De Talentos- Arquiteto De Dados (Aws)
description: Profissionais com interesse em tecnologia e no universo de dados podem se cadastrar em nosso Banco de Talentos – Arquiteto de Dados (AWS). Sobre a DataEX: Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA, com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar. Contexto: Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Arquitetura de Dados para liderar o desenho, a manutenção e a evolução do nosso ecossistema analítico. O desafio principal é consolidar um Data Lakehouse escalável de alta performance na AWS, garantindo excelência técnica, governança rigorosa e, fundamentalmente, eficiência de custos (FinOps). Escopo de atuação: Desenhar e implementar a arquitetura do Data Lakehouse. Definir padrões de modelagem de dados (ex: arquitetura medalhão) e estratégias de ingestão (batch e event-driven) Liderar a adoção de formatos de tabela abertos para viabilizar o Lakehouse e evitar vendor lock-in. FinOps Analítico: Monitorar, prever e otimizar implacavelmente os custos de processamento e armazenamento em nuvem. Ajustar particionamento, refatorar consultas pesadas e dimensionar clusters corretamente para garantir o máximo de ROI. Estabelecer políticas de governança, catálogos de dados e controle de acesso granular de ponta a ponta (LGPD compliance). Definir SLAs de qualidade de dados (Data Quality) e mecanismos de observabilidade dos pipelines. Evoluir a arquitetura para suportar o aumento de volumetria e novos casos de uso analíticos avançados e de IA. Atuar como referência técnica (mentor) para os times de Engenharia e Análise de Dados, promovendo as melhores práticas. Requisitos Técnicos Ecossistema AWS: Domínio em armazenamento e processamento: Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena e Amazon Redshift. Governança e Segurança: Experiência sólida na implementação do AWS Lake Formation. Integração e Performance: Vivência com Amazon EventBridge (arquiteturas orientadas a eventos) e Amazon ElastiCache (Redis). Ecossistema Open Source / Modern Data Stack: Experiência prática na adoção e configuração do Apache Iceberg como formato de tabela transacional no Data Lake. Domínio de orquestração de dados complexos com Apache Airflow. Proficiência na modelagem e transformação de dados utilizando dbt (Data Build Tool). Skills de Arquitetura: Sólida experiência prévia atuando no design de arquiteturas de dados complexas (não apenas operando). Mentalidade Cloud FinOps: capacidade comprovada de desenhar soluções equilibrando performance e custo. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Vale transporte Parceria com o SESC Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. É assim que seguimos expandindo possibilidades e construindo o maior grupo de moda da América Latina . Sonhar grande para fazer gigante — com gente boa e do bem. title: Lead Auditor
description: Lead credibility where it matters most. Shape how the global mining and metals sector demonstrates responsible, ethical, and socially sound performance. Why This Role Matters As global scrutiny on mining and metals intensifies—from investors, communities, regulators, and Indigenous Peoples—credible, independent assurance has never been more critical. In this executive‑level technical role, you will sit at the intersection of social performance, human rights, and operational accountability , ensuring mining organizations meet internationally recognized standards while building trust with affected stakeholders. Your expertise will directly support responsible resource development and meaningful social outcomes across global supply chains. What Your Impact Is Serve as a trusted authority delivering high‑quality certification and assurance audits against leading sustainability, social, and management system standards. Strengthen client credibility on human rights, labour practices, Indigenous engagement, and grievance mechanisms. Influence better industry outcomes by shaping audit findings into clear, actionable insights for senior decision‑makers. Help evolve ERM CVS’s assurance methodologies, raising the bar across the mining and metals sector worldwide. Required What You’ll Bring A Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in international development, social sciences, law, public policy, anthropology, resource management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in social impact assessment (SIA), FPIC, Indigenous Peoples’ rights, resettlement, or social performance within mining or related sectors. Proven audit experience, including: A minimum of 10 audits, or 3+ years where auditing represents at least 25% of professional responsibilities within the last 5 years. Practical exposure to on‑site mining or minerals operations. Strong working knowledge of social and ESG standards, including: IFC Performance Standards, SA8000, ILO conventions UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights OECD Due Diligence Guidance and related frameworks Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and explain complex findings to technical and non‑technical audiences. Willingness to travel internationally up to 50%. Preferred Lead Auditor qualification for ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, and/or ISO 50001. Hands‑on experience with voluntary mining standards such as IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM Mining Principles, ASI, RMI, or the Consolidated Mining Standard. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17021 accreditation requirements. Multilingual capability, particularly English, Spanish, and Portuguese (additional languages such as French or Bahasa are an asset). Experience mentoring auditors or supporting technical capability development within certification or assurance teams. Key Responsibilities Deliver third‑party certification and assurance audits across international standards, including ISO frameworks, IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM, ASI, and related social and ESG criteria. Evaluate client conformance, performance, and maturity across management systems and social performance requirements. title: Diretor(a) do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico
description: Descrição: 1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA DIRETORA DO HUB DE ENGAJAMENTO ESTRATÉGICO EM MSF-BRASIL? Você irá liderar a equipe multidisciplinar do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, integrando comunicação, gestão de marca, mobilização de recursos e parcerias estratégicas em uma estratégia consistente de engajamento com a sociedade brasileira, suportados por sistemas tecnológicos adequados e análise transversal de dados. Você também será responsável por garantir que as ações do Hub ampliem o conhecimento, a confiança e o engajamento do público brasileiro com a missão médico-humanitária de Médicos Sem Fronteiras e traduzam, de forma impactante e acessível, as realidades vividas pelas populações atendidas, fortalecendo a reputação institucional da organização e promovendo o crescimento sustentável da base de doadores e da receita proveniente de contribuições de indivíduos, empresas e outros parceiros. Além disso, você irá atuar como liderança estratégica responsável por desenvolver uma visão integrada para o Hub, promovendo o alinhamento contínuo entre as equipes multidisciplinares, tomada de decisão baseada em evidências, inovação contínua e foco em impactos mensuráveis, sempre em consonância com os princípios e valores da organização. 2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS? Liderar a transformação organizacional do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico e consolidá-lo como um ecossistema integrado de comunicação, marca, mobilização de recursos, dados, tecnologia e parcerias, conduzindo uma jornada gradual de amadurecimento organizacional, fortalecimento de lideranças e ampliação progressiva da autonomia das equipes, bem como fomentando colaboração entre áreas, fortalecendo a cultura de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e impulsionando a adoção de métodos ágeis pelos times do Hub em um ambiente dinâmico e multidisciplinar; Liderar a visão e a estratégia de posicionamento, engajamento e atração de recursos de MSF-Brasil, zelando pela reputação da Organização e garantindo alinhamento entre as diferentes células do Hub e com outras áreas de MSF-Brasil; Ampliar a base de apoiadores da organização, testando novas abordagens e engajando novas audiências por meio de estratégias inovadoras e ousadas, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade da operação de captação de recursos, e ampliando a contribuição de MSF-Brasil para o projetos médico-humanitários da organização. 3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO? Consolidação e Evolução do Hub Liderar o processo de consolidação do Hub por meio de uma abordagem faseada, equilibrando atuação direta em temas estratégicos e operacionais quando necessário com a construção gradual e progressiva da autonomia e da capacidade decisória das lideranças das células e suas equipes; Desenvolver e implementar a visão estratégica do Hub, alinhada ao Planejamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, monitorando resultados e ajustando prioridades com base em dados e aprendizados; Garantir a integração entre as diferentes células do Hub, promovendo alinhamento estratégico, colaboração e objetivos compartilhados; Liderar a evolução da estrutura, dos processos e dos modelos de trabalho do Hub, fortalecendo a inovação, a transformação organizacional, a cultura orientada por dados e as metodologias ágeis. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas Liderar, desenvolver e apoiar as lideranças das células do Hub, fortalecendo uma cultura de confiança, autonomia, accountability, colaboração e aprendizagem contínua; Promover um ambiente de trabalho ético, inclusivo e seguro, alinhado aos valores e compromissos comportamentais de MSF; Desenvolver capacidades de liderança, impulsionar a adoção de metodologias ágeis e estimular uma cultura de feedback e melhoria contínua. Estratégia de Engajamento, Marca e Mobilização de Recursos Liderar a definição e implementação da estratégia integrada de engajamento institucional de MSF-Brasil, garantindo alinhamento entre comunicação, marca, mobilização de recursos e relacionamento com públicos estratégicos; Fortalecer o posicionamento institucional e a reputação de MSF, incluindo a gestão de crises reputacionais e a consistência da comunicação multicanal; Impulsionar estratégias inovadoras para ampliar o engajamento da sociedade, fortalecer a base de apoiadores e promover o crescimento sustentável da receita; Representar a organização junto à mídia, parceiros institucionais, setor humanitário e demais públicos estratégicos. Gestão de Performance, Dados e Tecnologia Garantir que as estratégias e decisões do Hub sejam orientadas por dados, evidências e indicadores de desempenho; Definir e acompanhar indicadores estratégicos, promovendo uma cultura de inovação, aprendizagem contínua e melhoria de resultados; Assegurar a evolução e o uso estratégico de CRM, plataformas de dados, ferramentas digitais e capacidades analíticas voltadas ao engajamento e relacionamento com apoiadores; Liderar a priorização de iniciativas, investimentos e recursos, incluindo a gestão orçamentária do Hub. Representação Institucional e Articulação Global Atuar como principal ponto de articulação do Hub com lideranças regionais e internacionais de MSF, promovendo trocas de conhecimento, alinhamento estratégico e compartilhamento de melhores práticas; Contribuir para fóruns e discussões estratégicas internacionais relacionados a engajamento, comunicação, mobilização de recursos, marca, dados e inovação. Compromissos de Gestão de MSF-Brasil Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores, princípios e compromissos comportamentais da organização, promovendo gestão ética, inclusiva e colaborativa; Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico e o fortalecimento da atuação transversal entre áreas; Promover ativamente práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e respeitoso para todas as pessoas. Requisitos: 4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER? Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em posições de liderança estratégica, com gestão de equipes e condução de projetos e iniciativas organizacionais de alta complexidade; Vivência na definição e implementação de estratégias de comunicação, marketing, marca, engajamento de públicos, relacionamento e/ou mobilização de recursos; Experiência em transformação organizacional, gestão de mudança e fortalecimento de culturas orientadas por dados; Conhecimento e atuação com CRM, plataformas de relacionamento, automação, gestão de dados e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho; Experiência em planejamento estratégico, gestão orçamentária e tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Experiência em gestão de reputação institucional e comunicação de crise; Conhecimento em estratégias de marketing, gestão de projetos, metodologias ágeis e negociação; Compreensão de segmentação de públicos, jornadas de engajamento e métricas de aquisição, retenção e conversão; Inglês fluente; Conhecimento do Microsoft 365; Interesse por temas humanitários e pelas realidades que afetam comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade. 5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES? Pós-graduação ou MBA em Marketing, Estratégia, Inovação ou Gestão de Projetos; Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares; Experiência com MSF e/ou vivência em organizações internacionais, organizações da sociedade civil e/ou contextos de alta complexidade institucional; Experiência em prospecção e desenvolvimento de parcerias institucionais; Proficiência em Espanhol. 6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS? Você precisará ter visão estratégica e pensamento analítico para compreender cenários complexos, conectar diferentes perspectivas e utilizar dados e evidências na definição de estratégias e na tomada de decisões. Será importante demonstrar planejamento e organização para estabelecer prioridades, coordenar diferentes frentes de atuação e garantir o alinhamento das equipes aos objetivos da organização. Além disso, será necessário liderança para mobilizar pessoas em torno de uma visão compartilhada, promover colaboração e engajamento, e iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades, liderar mudanças e desenvolver novas soluções. Por fim, gerenciamento de estresse será essencial para manter equilíbrio, clareza e capacidade de decisão diante de cenários de pressão, mudanças e múltiplas demandas. PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA: MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans e PcD. PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 13/09/2026 RETORNO: Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Instrument Technician

Repair and calibrate all fire and gas systems. Repair and maintain all electronic control systems. Implement and follow through planned maintenance routines and schedules for all instrumentation. title: Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Redes
description: A Telespazio, joint venture entre Leonardo (67%) e Thales (33%), é uma líder global no setor de soluções e serviços satelitais. Fundada na Itália em 1961 e com sede em Roma, a empresa faz parte da Space Alliance, uma colaboração estratégica com a Thales Alenia Space que oferece uma ampla gama de serviços espaciais avançados. Com mais de 3.300 profissionais distribuídos entre suas filiais na Europa e América Latina, a Telespazio opera uma rede internacional de Centros Espaciais e Teleportos, fornecendo soluções inovadoras nas áreas de Geoinformação, Sistemas e Operações Satelitais e Comunicações via Satélite. Junte-se a nós enquanto continuamos a ultrapassar os limites do possível no espaço! Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Redes para atuar na sustentação, implementação, monitoramento, automação e evolução dos ambientes de redes corporativas, datacenters e infraestruturas críticas da empresa. O profissional terá atuação técnica hands‑on e papel de liderança, sendo responsável por garantir a disponibilidade, performance, segurança e resiliência dos serviços, além de atuar na resolução de incidentes, execução de mudanças e projetos de evolução da infraestrutura. Responsabilidades Coordenar e apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de Engenharia de Redes, contribuindo para a distribuição e acompanhamento das atividades. Administrar, sustentar e evoluir ambientes LAN, WAN, datacenter, conectividade corporativa e infraestrutura híbrida. Configurar e realizar troubleshooting em switches, roteadores, firewalls, balanceadores, VPNs e demais equipamentos de rede. Administrar políticas de segurança, regras de acesso, NAT, VPNs, segmentação e ambientes de alta disponibilidade. Monitorar disponibilidade, capacidade e performance da infraestrutura, utilizando ferramentas como Grafana, Zabbix, PRTG ou equivalentes. Atuar em incidentes de média e alta criticidade, realizando diagnóstico, recuperação dos serviços e análise de causa‑raiz. Automatizar rotinas de configuração, coleta de dados, inventário, backup, validação e monitoramento utilizando Python, Ansible, APIs ou ferramentas equivalentes. Planejar e executar mudanças em ambientes produtivos, contemplando análise de impacto, riscos, testes, validação e rollback. Apoiar projetos de implantação, expansão, migração e modernização da infraestrutura de redes, datacenters e ambientes híbridos. Realizar análises de capacidade, obsolescência e ciclo de vida dos equipamentos. Manter a documentação técnica atualizada e atuar em conjunto com áreas internas, operadoras, fornecedores e fabricantes. Requisitos Ensino superior completo em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em administração, sustentação e troubleshooting de redes TCP/IP. Conhecimento avançado em switching e routing, incluindo VLAN, STP, OSPF, BGP, VRF, MPLS, QoS e protocolos de alta disponibilidade. Experiência com firewalls, VPN IPsec, NAT, ACL, segmentação e segurança de redes. Vivência em ambientes corporativos, datacenters ou infraestruturas de missão crítica. Experiência com equipamentos de fabricantes como Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, MikroTik, Check Point, Datacom ou equivalentes. Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade utilizando Zabbix, Grafana, PRTG, SNMP, Syslog ou ferramentas equivalentes. Conhecimento em automação de redes utilizando Python, Ansible, APIs REST, Git, Shell, PowerShell ou tecnologias equivalentes. Experiência na execução de mudanças em ambientes produtivos e atuação em incidentes críticos. Capacidade de análise de tráfego, logs, métricas e captura de pacotes para diagnóstico de problemas de conectividade, latência, jitter, perda de pacotes e indisponibilidade. Capacidade de elaboração e manutenção de documentação técnica, diagramas físicos e lógicos e inventário de infraestrutura. Experiência em liderança técnica ou coordenação de equipes de Engenharia de Redes. Diferenciais Certificação Cisco CCNP. Certificação Juniper JNCIS. Certificações Fortinet Certified Professional ou equivalentes. Certificações MikroTik MTCNA ou MTCRE. Experiência com conectividade cloud e infraestrutura híbrida. Experiência em automação e padronização de infraestrutura de redes. Vivência em projetos de migração, expansão ou modernização de datacenters. title: CHEFE DE CONFEITARIA

title: COORDENADOR DE PÓS-VENDAS | SERVIÇOS E PEÇAS – LINHA PESADA
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de COORDENADOR DE PÓS-VENDAS | SERVIÇOS E PEÇAS – LINHA PESADA abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso! Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Sua missão: Liderar as operações de oficina, balcão de peças e almoxarifado; Garantir performance operacional, comercial e financeira da área; Desenvolver estratégias e planos de ação voltados ao crescimento de receita, produtividade e rentabilidade; Fortalecer relacionamento com clientes, ampliando fidelização e geração de negócios; Gerir indicadores, processos, custos, qualidade e desempenho da operação; Desenvolver e engajar equipes, promovendo cultura de resultado, disciplina e excelência; Atuar diretamente na alavancagem de vendas de serviços, identificando oportunidades, ampliando ticket médio e mix de serviços; Desenvolver relacionamento com clientes, garantindo alto nível de satisfação, fidelização e recorrência; Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da empresa, garantindo agilidade e eficiência operacional. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo emEngenharia Mecânica, Administração, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia Mecânica, Logistica ou áreas correlatas; Experiência com liderança de equipe em ambiente de oficina; Conhecimento técnico em manutenção automotiva pesada; Vivência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou vendas de serviços será um diferencial importante; Boa comunicação e postura comercial Vantagens/Benefícios: Ticket Alimentação-pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família. Defendemos nossos valores de respeito aos clientes, às pessoas, aos acionistas, ao meio ambiente e aos fatos em todos os lugares onde estamos presentes. Nós nos importamos em dar as pessoas uma melhor maneira de seguir em frente. Seja parte de um time no qual você é empoderado e encorajado a alcançar o seu potencial ao máximo e a realizar as suas ambições. Ao redor do mundo, através da diversidade, ajude a criar o futuro da Michelin com paixão, entusiasmo e orgulho. Com a mesma atenção aos nossos colaboradores e clientes, nós inovamos além e melhor pela sustentabilidade. Valorizamos as singularidades de cada um e consideramos a diversidade como um valor, por isso reforçamos este convite para você, que se autodeclara negro ou negra , do gênero feminino ou masculino , LGBTQIA+ , pessoa com deficiência ou acima de 50 anos. Conheça mais sobre o site que você irá trabalhar: O Complexo industrial de Itatiaia/RJ é responsável pela produção de Reforços Metálicos que dão a força ao pneu e também, Pneus para Carros de passeio e Caminhonetes que abastecem o mercado mundial. Prefira a Michelin para crescer! Missão: Realizar análises de risco para antecipar potenciais problemas e garantir uma industrialização eficiente dos produtos, atendendo aos requisitos do CDC (desempenho industrial, desempenho do produto, custo e prazo) e assegurando o lançamento no mercado dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Atuar na definição do modelo cru do produto e na condução da industrialização, além de realizar análises de causa raiz e implementar ações corretivas para solucionar desvios identificados em projetos e processos de fabricação. Principais atividades: Industrializar pneus robustos, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos de arquitetura, qualidade, padronização, custo e prazo. Elaborar e conduzir o planejamento da qualidade, realizando análises de riscos para a industrialização de novos produtos e dimensões. Apoiar as fábricas na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos e de produção. Conduzir projetos de industrialização com escopo e complexidade moderados, assegurando a entrega dos resultados esperados. Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos, contribuindo para a excelência operacional e a competitividade dos produtos. Principais Resultados Esperados: Garantir a industrialização de produtos dentro dos padrões de qualidade, custo e prazo. Antecipar riscos e implementar ações preventivas para evitar impactos na produção. Resolver problemas de fabricação por meio de metodologias estruturadas de análise de causa raiz. Apoiar as unidades fabris na busca pela excelência operacional. Assegurar lançamentos de produtos com desempenho e confiabilidade alinhados às expectativas do mercado. Pré-requisitos: Experiência prévia na área; Formação Acadêmica: Engenharia; Idiomas: Inglês B1; Local de trabalho/base: Resende. Atenção: Informamos que não contratamos empresas terceiras que cobrem dos candidatos para a participação em nossos processos. title: Lead Fraud Data Scientist
description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About the role As a Lead Data Scientist for our Fraud team, you will be on the front lines of protecting our company and our customers. You will leverage your expertise in machine learning, statistics, and data analysis to design, build, and deploy sophisticated models that detect and prevent fraudulent activity in real-time. This is a high-impact role where you will see your work directly translate into protecting millions of dollars and ensuring a trustworthy platform for our users. Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Strategy: Define the long-term machine learning strategy for the fraud team, establish technical best practices, and mentor junior data scientists. End-to-End Model Development: Own the entire lifecycle of fraud detection models, from data exploration and feature engineering to model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Credit & Lending Fraud Mitigation: Design and develop models specifically targeted at lending fraud typologies, including synthetic identity fraud, first-party loan default fraud, and application fraud. Advanced Analysis: Conduct deep-dive investigations into emerging fraud patterns and user behavior, using clustering, outlier detection, network analysis, and other unsupervised techniques to uncover hidden risks and organized fraud rings. Experimentation: Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of new models, rules, and strategies on both fraud detection rates and user experience. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to translate business needs into data science solutions, seamlessly integrate ML scores with rule engines, and communicate complex results to non-technical audiences. Productionalize Models: Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models in a cloud environment, ensuring high availability and performance. Reporting & Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards using tools like Tableau or Looker to track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as fraud loss rates, false positive rates, and model performance. Requirements Must-Haves Experience: 5+ years of experience in a hands-on data science role, building and deploying machine learning models. Leadership: Proven experience leading complex data science projects from inception to production, including setting technical direction and guiding peers. Python: Expert-level Python for data analysis and modeling (pandas, scikit-learn, etc.). SQL: Advanced SQL skills for complex data extraction and manipulation. Machine Learning Modeling: Deep experience with tree-based ML models (XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM) and statistical models (Logistic Regression, Lasso/Ridge). Model Explainability & Ethics: Deep understanding of model explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and algorithmic fairness to ensure models comply with credit lending regulations. Sampling Techniques: Strong understanding of sampling techniques for handling highly imbalanced datasets. Unsupervised Learning: Practical experience with clustering and outlier detection techniques (e.g., K-Means, K Nearest Neighbors, Isolation Forest). Model Lifecycle & Cloud: Proven experience with the full modeling lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and maintenance on a cloud platform like GCP, AWS, or Azure. Analytical Rigor: A solid foundation in statistics and experience designing and analyzing A/B tests. Communication: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Advanced English level. Nice to have Domain Experience: Direct experience in a FinTech, payments, or risk/fraud-focused role, particularly with exposure to credit or consumer lending. Alternative & Bureau Data: Experience working with traditional credit bureau data (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion) and alternative credit/identity data sources. Graph ML: Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph analytics tools (e.g., Neo4j, NetworkX) to map complex fraud networks. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with consumer lending regulations (e.g., FCRA, ECOA) and their impact on machine learning model development. MLOps: Hands-on MLOps experience (e.g., CI/CD for models, versioning, automated retraining). GCP / Vertex AI: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially Vertex AI. Spanish and/or Portuguese speaker These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. title: AMZL Sr. Station Leader , AMZL Logistics (Fulfillment & Operations)
description: AMZL Sr. Station Leader is responsible for all budgetary, people development and operations objectives for an Amazon Logistics Delivery Station (DS). Additional responsibilities include managing and leading a team of Operations, Area and Shift Managers, coaching and mentoring the team to ensure performance objectives are met, building positive employee relations and building leadership bench strength within the DS. Lead all delivery station operations with full accountability for safety, quality, performance, customer experience, and people development. Set clear expectations for Operations, Area, and Shift Managers, measure their performance, and provide coaching to support their growth and accountability. Build and execute a comprehensive talent plan that includes recruitment, performance management, learning and development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives. Manage 24/7 operations handling Amazon last-mile deliveries, oversee relationships with multiple Delivery Service Partners, and present operational metrics to senior leadership. Partner with key stakeholders across Transport & Sortation, Finance, HR, Loss Prevention, and Engineering to secure resources and implement strategic improvement initiatives. A day in the life As Senior Station Leader, you'll oversee all aspects of delivery station operations, from managing safety and quality metrics to coaching your Operations, Area, and Shift Managers through real-time challenges. You might start your day reviewing overnight performance data, then move into coaching conversations with your management team about process improvements. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with Delivery Service Partners on logistics coordination, analyze operational metrics for senior leadership presentations, and identify opportunities to streamline workflows. You'll also dedicate time to talent development. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays Experience in people management Preferred Qualifications Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Global EHS Compliance Senior Specialist - Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) - Rio de J[...]
description: About Abbott Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology. Working at Abbott At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to: Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. Benefits such as Medical and Dental Assistance, Life Insurance, Private Pension Plan, Medication Subsidy, Discount on Abbott stock purchases, among others. A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. We offer flexible work policies that allow a healthy balance between personal and professional life We invest in the development of our employees through training andgrowth opportunities We foster an environment where every voice is heard and valued Primary Job Function: Establish, maintain, and provide subject matter expertise for formal divisional management systems and programs across EHS risk management disciplines—including industrial hygiene, process safety, loss prevention, and machine guarding—while also supporting relevant environmental management aspects related to water, waste, and air emissions across EPD manufacturing sites. Act as a supporting function to the divisional program managing EHS risk for key Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) suppliers and third‑party manufacturers, contributing guidance and technical support to internal and external stakeholders. Core Job Responsibilities: Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing groups to actively support process design, development, and manufacturing, ensuring early identification and reduction of risks associated with the primary job function technical areas. Provide support across process design, development, and manufacturing to drive waste weight reduction, enhance waste diversion outcomes, and advance circular economy objectives. Provide guidance to sites supporting alignment with applicable process safety and occupational safety standards and frameworks, consistent with Abbott Corporate EHS requirements. Support the identification and evaluation of higher‑risk processes, equipment, materials, and operations by providing technical input, recommended assessment approaches, and risk‑based guidance. Contribute to divisional EHS performance by providing subject matter input and technical guidance during internal or external reviews, assessments, and reporting activities related to operational EHS risk disciplines. Contribute to strategic planning activities for operational EHS risk disciplines by supporting periodic program effectiveness reviews, self‑assessments, and discussions related to operational, product, or regulatory changes. Collaborate with Abbott EHS leadership in a technical advisory capacity to support understanding of EHS management approaches, key risks, and potential business impacts related to process and occupational safety disciplines. Facilitate and participate in subject matter expert (SME) networks across the EPD network, serving as a technical liaison with Global EHS for these disciplines. Collaborate with Abbott EHS leaders to understand EHS management, issues, and business impacts. Provide support that all significant EHS aspects and activities are integrated in the Process Lifecycle management. Review and provide input for divisional or site Requests for Capital Expenditure (RCE) to ensure that all significant EHS aspects and activities are properly integrated during the entire Front-End Planning Design Process for new product introduction and global product-transfers and changes/upgrades to existing processes and equipment. Enable and support the development and maintenance of formal environmental management systems and programs for water, waste, and air emissions, ensuring adequate oversight. Partner with Operations to ensure sustainability requirements are incorporated into process design and development and product transfer activities supporting New Product Introduction. Support the development and implementation of EPD strategies across internal and external manufacturing sites to improve wastewater quality by reducing API concentrations in effluent (e.g., Antimicrobial Resistance Initiative). Identify emerging regulations or new requirements impacting EPD products or chemicals used by EPD sites, communicate to the other EPD functions and ensure actions are put in place. Keep current on emerging regulatory issues that may impact the business, and provide innovative, achievable, and practical solutions to EPD sites Liaise with the regional EHS leaders to engage the procurement functions to ensure EHS risks are known and understood relating to key TPM’s and suppliers. Build strong relationships to engage and influence Abbott EPD Supply Chain management on EHS performance improvements and provide technical in-depth EHS knowledge to ensure focus on key risks. Position Accountability/Scope: Position has global EPD responsibility on developing and supporting the execution of the tactical plan on Environmental Sustainability programs for water, waste and air emissions in line with Abbott Corporate EHS Strategy. Position will work very closely with applicable EHS and Management personnel at site, divisional and Corporate EHS level. Minimum Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in EHS, Engineering, science, or equivalent technical experience plus demonstrated competence with 5+ years of EHS experience in the pharmaceutical and/or chemical industries. Minimum Experience/Training Required: Sustainability experience in the following areas is preferred: water management, API (active pharmaceutical ingredients), circular economy, chemicals handing and waste. Serves as a role model for behaviors outlined in the Abbott Competency Cluster. Industry experience in the following areas is preferred: third party manufacturing, finished drugs, API, chemicals, plastics & packaging 5+ years experience working in corporate business enviroment with senior management, plant managers, and plant EHS managers. Positive track record of establishing and maintaining effective relationships with internal and external clients. Demonstrated ability to successfully negotiate with peers, superiors, customers, regulators and governmental officials. Extensive team leadership experience involving cross-divisional and cross-functional participants is required. Needs to be able to travel approximately 40%. Fluency in English a must, Spanish is desirable. additional languages such as Portuguese, Dutch, German, Russian is a plus. Exhibit high degree of business judgment, interpersonal, negotiations and communication skills with multiple functions, business units and external partners to successfully perform the role. Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity. Connect with us at on Facebook at and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Technical Lead ID71009
description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Technical Lead to drive end-to-end application engineering for a large-scale marketing analytics platform, serving as the primary owner of code quality and application architecture. You will lead the design and deployment of containerized Python and React applications, integrate complex business logic and AI-powered features into an existing platform, collaborate closely with DevOps teams, and guide senior engineers while ensuring alignment with established engineering standards and long-term maintainability. You will also help shape solutions in an often ambiguous, fast-moving environment by gathering context, defining problems, and turning loosely defined needs into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. WHAT YOU WILL DO Code Governance: Review all PRs and enforce code quality standards, preventing "spaghetti code" and scope creep. System Architecture: Design and deploy containerized applications using REST APIs. Technical Integration: Embed complex logic, AI features, and outputs from data-heavy backends into the platform without disrupting existing workflows. AWS Ecosystem Engagement: Working knowledge of the data stack (S3-backed data lake queried via Athena, EKS/Kubernetes) and of how orchestrated pipelines feed the application — enough to collaborate with DevOps and clarify functional/non-functional requirements, without owning the analytical pipeline architecture directly. Team Leadership: Guide senior developers and ensure alignment with established engineering practices. MUST HAVES 7+ years of full-stack engineering experience with a strong track record of architectural ownership. Strong production experience with Python (FastAPI or Flask). Solid TypeScript/React experience (Next.js or modern state management is a plus). Comfortable with REST APIs , including migrating away from legacy GraphQL endpoints where needed. Docker and relational databases (PostgreSQL) , including comfort with database migrations. Demonstrated experience building or maintaining data-heavy applications (large payloads/datasets, performance-sensitive queries at the application layer). AWS Ecosystem : working familiarity with object-storage-backed data lakes and serverless query engines (S3 + Athena or equivalent) and with EKS/Kubernetes concepts — enough to drive DevOps conversations and reason about how data reaches the application. Hands-on pipeline design not required. Task orchestration awareness: familiar with what a DAG-based orchestrator like Airflow does, or able to pick it up quickly from experience with a comparable engine. Won't be managing Airflow itself. Highly comfortable in Mac/Linux terminal-centric environments (Bash, Makefiles). Practical, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code), paired with the critical judgment to challenge AI output when it compromises long-term maintainability — including the leadership presence to set the standard for how the team uses AI tooling responsibly (e.g., flagging risky AI-driven shortcuts during PR review). Strong soft skills: the ability to hold and defend a technical opinion — challenging a stakeholder's or a tool's proposed "quick fix" with sound reasoning in pursuit of a solution that scales and is maintainable long-term, while still being pragmatic enough to ship. Comfort with ambiguity (mandatory) : work is frequently ad hoc and underspecified. This role requires defining the problem — gathering context, identifying constraints, and framing the work — before solving it, rather than waiting for a specification. Experience limited to well-specified work executed through agent workflows is not a fit. NICE TO HAVES Direct production experience with Athena, S3-based data lakes, or Airflow. Production AI features using AWS Bedrock, LangChain, Pydantic AI, or similar. Monorepo tooling (Nx) or modern package managers (Poetry, UV, Yarn). NoSQL/caching layers (Redis). Exposure to OLAP-style analytics tools (Trino/Presto, ClickHouse, SageMaker) as a plus, not a requirement. Experience with marketing data structures, campaign management APIs, or digital advertising metrics. PERKS AND BENEFITS Growth without limits : build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget Competitive compensation : get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews Flexibility : work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm Meaningful, modern projects : build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands Collaborative culture : join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized Well-being & support : access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Full Stack Developer ID71007
description: WHY JOIN US AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build and maintain backend services and frontend interfaces that surface, validate, and resolve issues in data coming from ETL pipelines, data lake outputs, and ML model results for a large-scale marketing analytics platform. You will develop REST APIs in Python using FastAPI or Flask, build responsive React and TypeScript frontends, manage PostgreSQL schemas and migrations, and leverage AI-assisted development tools with the critical judgment to push back on shortcuts that compromise long-term maintainability. You will work in an environment where requirements are often ad hoc and underspecified, taking ownership of defining the problem, gathering context, identifying constraints, and shaping practical solutions before implementation. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and maintain scalable backend services (REST APIs) and responsive frontend interfaces (React/TypeScript). Build the interfaces and services that surface, validate, and resolve issues in data coming from the data lake, ETL pipelines, health-check logic, or model outputs — without necessarily owning pipeline architecture. Package and manage applications using Docker. Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) to move fast during implementation — while critically evaluating AI-generated output and pushing back when it isn't the right long-term solution. Drive conversations directly with engineers to clarify both functional and non-functional requirements, rather than defaulting to whatever "just works" in the short term. Work daily alongside engineers over Slack and Google Meet. MUST HAVES 5–7 years of full-stack software development experience . Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or Flask) and TypeScript/React . Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and database migrations . Comfortable with REST APIs ; able to work with and migrate away from legacy GraphQL where needed. Demonstrated experience building or maintaining data-heavy applications (large datasets, performance-sensitive queries at the application layer). Practical, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools , paired with the critical judgment to challenge AI output when it compromises long-term maintainability. High comfort level working entirely in a Mac/Linux terminal environment (Bash, Makefiles). Strong soft skills (mandatory, not a bonus) : the ability to hold and defend a technical opinion — challenging a stakeholder's or a tool's proposed "quick fix" with sound reasoning in pursuit of a solution that scales and is maintainable long-term, while still being pragmatic enough to ship. Comfort with ambiguity (mandatory) : work is frequently ad hoc and underspecified. This role requires defining the problem — gathering context, identifying constraints, and framing the work — before solving it, rather than waiting for a specification. Experience limited to well-specified work executed through agent workflows is not a fit. NICE TO HAVES Exposure to object-storage-backed data lakes and serverless query engines (S3 + Athena, or comparable — Trino/Presto, BigQuery, Spark SQL). Familiarity with DAG-based task orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Step Functions), or the ability to pick it up quickly. Data engineering exposure — experience building or maintaining ETL pipelines, advanced SQL (complex queries, data validation, optimization). Caching/NoSQL systems (Redis, DynamoDB). Monorepo tooling or modern package managers (Nx, Poetry, UV). Familiarity with AWS Bedrock or similar AI/LLM SDKs. Experience with marketing data structures, campaign management APIs, or digital advertising metrics. PERKS AND BENEFITS Growth without limits : build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget Competitive compensation : get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews Flexibility : work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm Meaningful, modern projects : build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands Collaborative culture : join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized Well-being & support : access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Talent Acquisition Advisor
description: Global, inclusive and innovative - welcome to AMS, where talent connects across cultures and backgrounds to shape the future of work. We work with leading organizations to design and deliver talent strategies that bring together people, process, data and technology, helping millions of people find meaningful work every year. Our diverse, connected community collaborates to create results for clients and opportunities for our people to learn, grow and make an impact. At AMS, we look for people who bring more than experience, and we welcome different perspectives and ways of thinking. The Role: What if your skills mattered more than your job title? We are seeking a proactive and consultative Talent Acquisition Advisor to manage end-to-end recruitment strategies across key business units. In this role, you will act as a trusted talent partner to hiring managers—advising on market conditions, candidate assessment frameworks, diversity initiatives, and competitive offer strategies. The ideal candidate brings strong full-lifecycle recruiting expertise, a candidate-centric approach, and the ability to influence hiring decisions through data and talent market insights. Key Accountabilities: What you’ll do: Intake & Strategy: Lead structured kick-off/intake sessions with hiring managers to define role requirements, key competencies, interview loops, and targeted sourcing plans. Advisory & Influence: Provide continuous guidance to hiring teams on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, interview best practices, and mitigate hiring bias. Market Intelligence: Gather and share real-time candidate feedback, competitor talent trends, and labor market data to refine active searches. Skills & Requirements: Sourcing & Attraction: Execute targeted sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking groups, and employee referral channels to build diverse, passive pipelines. Screening & Evaluation: Conduct thorough competency-based phone screens to assess candidate qualifications, career motivation, and cultural alignment. Pipeline Management: Drive candidates smoothly through the interview process, ensuring clear communication, timely feedback loops, and an outstanding candidate experience. Language: Spanish, Portuguese and English If you don’t meet every requirement but you feel you have the right skills and potential, we want to hear from you. Why AMS?: At AMS, we come from every walk of life - and that’s what makes us unique. Our culture is open, inclusive and built on trust. We empower our people with the flexibility and autonomy to work in ways that bring out their best. We offer career opportunities in every direction you want to explore. We offer Growth and development focused on your strengths A team that values being Passionate, Bold, and Authentic Supportive communities such as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) Volunteer day - you get one additional paid day off each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you Our statement We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate based upon age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. If you require any accommodations or have any accessibility needs, please reach out via email or make a member of our Talent Acquisition team aware at any time. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Comprador PL.
description: A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas. Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características. Responsabilidades e atribuições Conduzir processos de compras de materiais (Spot, Contratos e Emergênciais) garantindo a melhor preço, prazo e condições para a companhia; Elaborar e executar estratégias de sourcing.Realizar cotações, negociações e equalizações técnicas e comerciais; Emitir e acompanhar pedidos de compra; Garantir o atendimento aos prazos acordados com os clientes internos; Negociar preços, prazos, condições de pagamento, garantias e níveis de serviço (SLA); Buscar oportunidades de redução de custos (Savings) e ganho de eficiência; Desenvolver alternativas de fornecimento para mitigação de riscos; Prospectar, homologar e desenvolver novos fornecedores; Elaborar escopos e conduzir processos concorrenciais de contratos; Apoiar a elaboração, renovação e aditivos de contratos; Monitorar vigência contratual para evitar descontinuidade de contratos e preços acordados; Garantir aderência às políticas internas e requisitos legais; Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento das demandas; Monitorar indicadores como: SLA, Saving, Follow-up e relatórios gerenciais; Requisitos e qualificações Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins; Pacote Office avançado, com ênfase em Excel; Power BI - desejável; Experiência com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente SAP e SAP Ariba; Conhecimento nos portais V360 e 4MDG - desejável; Conhecimento em Strategic Sourcing; Domínio de técnicas de negociação; Experiência em análise de custos e TCO (Total Cost of Ownership). title: SUPERVISOR ASSISTENCIAL UNIDADE

Fazer acompanhamento para garantir a resolução e endereçar qualquer impacto negativo; Garantir clareza de informações e alinhamento de expectativas com os pacientes, familiares e acompanhantes baseado nas normativas institucionais; Trabalhar junto às áreas assistenciais e administrativas, mobilizando e engajando os colaboradores na cultura da experiência do paciente; Monitorar manifestações e tendências na plataforma ECO e in-loco; Construir e estruturar o Conselho Consultivo de pacientes e familiares com o objetivo de melhorar a experiencia hospitalar; Promover ações de melhoria sobre a experiência do colaborador, atuando de forma criativa e nas ações que tangem a melhoria da jornada do colaborador na instituição; Trabalhar gestão emocional das equipes em conjunto com o serviço social, psicologia e Recursos Humanos; Mensurar, através de indicadores, a efetividade dos novos projetos e ações de adesão dos pacientes em relação as respostas a pesquisa de satisfação e de engajamento dos colaboradores; Apoiar na transformação cultural dos times e entender o paciente e seus familiares como contribuintes para o cuidado coordenado, fortalecendo vínculos e proporcionando um ambiente com segurança emocional; Apoiar os líderes de porta, na elaboração de planos de ações em que consigam traduzir a percepção do paciente em melhoria real e sustentada; Integrar e participar das reuniões de Governança clínica, focando na segurança e qualidade percebida pelo paciente, na capacitação contínua das equipes assegurando um atendimento de alto padrão de excelência. title: Fonoaudiólogo (a)
description: O Fonoaudiólogo (a) é responsável por realizar avaliações, diagnósticos e intervenções em pacientes com distúrbios de comunicação, voz, audição e deglutição, atuando sob supervisão e contribuindo para a promoção da saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes. Sua atuação envolve também a orientação de pacientes e familiares, além de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para oferecer um atendimento integral e de qualidade, promovendo a reabilitação e a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos atendidos. Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes durante o tratamento, ajustando as intervenções conforme a resposta ao tratamento e documentando todas as atividades realizadas de forma detalhada e organizada. Prestar orientações a pacientes, familiares e equipes de saúde sobre estratégias de comunicação, cuidados com a audição, higiene vocal e prevenção de distúrbios, promovendo a conscientização e o autocuidado. Participar de reuniões multidisciplinares, contribuindo com informações clínicas relevantes para o planejamento e execução do tratamento, além de colaborar na elaboração de planos de cuidado integrados. title: Marine Control Room Operator
description: Cargo, Ballast & Marine Systems Operations Operate, monitor, and troubleshoot marine systems related to the storage and export of stabilized crude oil, including ballast systems and Inert Gas (IG) systems; Be responsible for Inert Gas (IG) system venting operations, including gas freeing and purging of the IG system, ensuring vent outlets and mast risers are operated in accordance with ISGOTT and manufacturer procedures; Continuously monitor wind speed and direction during IG venting operations, assessing the extent of the hazardous gas dispersion zone and suspending or adjusting venting activities when wind conditions could direct hydrocarbon vapors toward occupied areas, the helideck, or ignition sources; Prepare load and discharge plans for cargo and ballast, cargo calculations, cargo/slop/ballast tank entry, and cargo/slop/ballast tank condition monitoring; Operate and monitor cargo offloading systems, mooring and positioning telemetry systems, and communication systems used during offloading operations with dynamically positioned shuttle tankers; Prepare and assist the marine team with Crude Oil Washing (COW) operations, water washing, tank gas freeing, and preparation of cargo and ballast tanks for entry; assist with inspection of cargo and ballast tanks as per the Computerized Maintenance Management System; Responsible for ensuring that the FPSO's intact stability and structural strength are at all times maintained within safe operating envelopes; Operate tank gauging systems (radar level gauges) and perform custody transfer measurements/draft surveys in accordance with ISGOTT and ANP requirements; Liaise with the Operations Control Room Operator (CRO) as required to ensure stable operations. Environmental & Regulatory Compliance Operate and monitor the Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment (ODME) and other pollution-prevention systems during Slop discharge operations, ensuring compliance with MARPOL Annex I requirements and maintaining environmental discharge records; Assist the Marine Superintendent in preparing for and supporting surveys and audits conducted by the Directorate of Ports and Coasts (DPC), Classification Society, and Flag State, ensuring that required documentation, certificates, and records are organized and readily available; Support helideck inspections and audits (structural, firefighting equipment, and operational readiness) conducted by DPC, Classification Society, or per company/international standards (e.g., CAP 437), ensuring compliance findings are logged and communicated to the Marine Superintendent; Prepare and submit all documentation required regarding cargo export, such as Cargo Quality and Quantity Origin Safety, Emergency Response & SIMOPS Identify and report marine equipment faults and breakdowns; use IFS to generate work orders if required; Coordinate and monitor Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS) involving cargo/ballast, crane, supply boat, and helicopter activities to prevent conflicting operations; Liaise with the Marine Superintendent regarding planning of offloading operations, including but not limited to potential weather challenges and operational conflicts in terms of helicopter and supply boat operations; Monitor weather in general, as well as report and announce when weather criteria defined in the heavy weather plan or operating procedure have been reached or breached, and suspend operations as appropriate; Monitor all internal and external communications, as well as Closed Circuit TV (CCTV); Liaise with the Emergency Response and Rescue Vessel on a daily basis as required; Monitor vessel activity inside the 500m safety zone; Monitor shipping traffic in the vicinity of the FPSO that may pose a threat to the FPSO; Prioritize workload to ensure safety-critical backlog is kept to a minimum; Act as a role model for safety, promoting a strong safety culture through active participation and leadership in safety meetings, briefings, toolbox talk and training sessions. Reporting, Handover & Documentation Complete the necessary daily reporting concerning marine aspects of the overall operation; Maintain Central Control Room (CCR) operations shift log and conduct shift handover; Provide clear and concise daily work logs of events during the shift and give a comprehensive handover to back-to-backs of all events and information relevant to time on duty, including updates on plant conditions, standing/daily instructions, and status of work permits within the assigned area. Handovers are regarded as critical to the safe operation of platform systems and equipment; Liaise with the Laboratory Technician for proper analysis of exported crude. Team, Vendor & Training Coordination Liaise with other departments for coordination of maintenance activities; Use the IFS Maintenance Management System to generate work orders and update records; Carry out marine consumables stock control as required; Use the Permit to Work system; prepare permits and adhere to Permit to Work requirements; Ensure that vendors and contractors are managed safely and effectively; Undertaking training, both on and offshore, relevant to the position; Perform on-the-job training for newly started colleagues on marine systems and procedures; participate in emergency preparedness drills, safety meetings, and on-the-job training; MODU Code Ballast / Stability training and certification is mandatory. Minimum of OOW Unlimited Class II/1 is desirable. Eperience on FPSOs, Shuttle Tankers or Conventional Tankers. Fluent Oral and Written English. Solas, ISGOTT, ISM Code and MARPOL. Offshore Experience in Brazil is desirable. Previous work in a multinational environment is desirable. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Regional Operational Procurement Manager - Brazil
description: Regional Operational Procurement Manager - Brazil Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international humanitarian aid organization that provides assistance in more than 70 countries to populations in distress, to victims of natural or manmade disasters and to victims of armed conflicts, without discrimination and irrespective of origin, religion, creed or political affiliation. CONTEXT The Regional Operational Procurement Manager (ROPM) is based in Brazil and supports procurement and purchasing activities across the Latin America region, driven by operational needs in countries such as Brazil, Venezuela, Haiti, the Dominican Republic, with the flexibility to expand to other countries in the region as operational requirements evolve. The position works in strategic alignment and complementarity with other MSF entities, mainly the Global Procurement Unit (GPU) and the Americas Supply Initiative (ASU), as well as MSF Sections in the region (when relevant and by mutual agreement), ensuring mutual support and contributing to the development of a common MSF procurement ecosystem in the region through collaboration, mutualization and knowledge sharing across the regional actors. The ROPM acts as the procurement focal point and partner for OCB operations in the region, ensuring procurement strategies, supplier management and operational support are aligned with OCB operational priorities and needs. The role supports both procurement and purchasing activities across the end-to-end sourcing lifecycle, ensuring that procurement strategies, contracts and supplier relationships effectively translate into operational results and continuity of supply. The role covers both goods and services. It provides guidance, expertise and hands‑on support to country and project teams. It also contributes to regional procurement initiatives and strategies in alignment with ASU/GPU. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Provide guidance, advice and hands‑on support to country and project teams on OCB procurement and purchasing activities, procurement strategies, supplier management, and emergency procurement preparedness, including support for specific operational projects when required. Support country and project teams in strengthening local procurement practices and purchasing processes, ensuring alignment with operational priorities and MSF standards. Maintain regular alignment with Cell 5 Supply Front Officers and relevant stakeholders to ensure continuity, organizational memory, follow‑up of strategic procurement decisions, and identification of operational improvement opportunities and root causes affecting procurement and purchasing performance. Strengthen procurement capacity across the region through coaching, mentoring, training and knowledge sharing tailored to OCB operational needs, and support the implementation and adaptation of procurement tools, processes and standards, including cross‑functional initiatives such as the Guideline for Logisticians, while contributing to and promoting participation in the regional and global procurement community of practice. In coordination with GPU/ASU, contribute to market, supplier and regulatory intelligence to support operational decision‑making, and to the development and implementation of regional procurement strategies and initiatives, especially when those are aligned with OCB operational priorities.
